batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b MM Sharma

batting.name: LS Livingstone
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b Noor Ahmad

batting.name: Ashutosh Sharma
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b R Sai Kishore

batting.name: Harpreet Singh
batting.dismissal: run out (WP Saha, B Sai Sudharsan)

batting.name: Harpreet Brar
batting.dismissal: c M Shahrukh Khan b R Sai Kishore

batting.name: HV Patel
batting.dismissal: c M Shahrukh Khan b MM Sharma

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c Ashutosh Sharma b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c K Rabada b LS Livingstone

batting.name: Azmatullah Omarzai
batting.dismissal: c JM Sharma b HV Patel

batting.name: Rashid Khan
batting.dismissal: c RR Rossouw b HV Patel

balls.text: bunts a shot away to deep square leg, and they take off for a couple of runs, but the throw from the deep to Saha is decent, and the keeper throws the balls with both hands onto the stumps. And the smart work has resulted in Bhatia being run out at the keeper's end by an inch! Story of the PBKS innings... Punjab Kings bowled out for 142
offcutter around off stump, and he swings across the line to smack it to deep midwicket. Turns down the single again! Murmur in the crowd
slower ball, full and wide. Scythes a mistimed shot to deep point. Turns down the run
slower ball, full and wide. Tries to cut but gets an inside edge towards the keeper. They pinch one as Saha takes aim at the stumps. Direct hit would've been very tight

full ball outside off stump. Slot length and Harshal smacks it down the V, but Shahrukh is lurking on the long-on boundary again. Harshal got a solid connection there but the slower ball was the difference between him clearing the fence and falling short
good length ball outside leg. He stays leg-side of the ball and flat-bats a shot to long on

six? Looks like, but no, Shahrukh Khan is a tall man and he earns his fellow Tamil Nadu team-mate a four-for. It was an overpitched ball on off and Brar did really well to get the bat under it to get the elevation, but it wasn't enough on this occasion as SRK jumps up and grabs the ball from only inches inside the boundary line
mauled into the sightscreen! Sai tries to bowl full outside off again but Brar uses his feet and his long levers well to smack it for six more
full ball outside off but Brar fetches it from there and attacks the smaller side of the field. Rattles a slog sweep to deep midwicket
nearly a yorker-length delivery around off. Swiped back to the bowler's left, and Sai does well to intercept

full and wide ball outside off. Brar throws his bat at this, smacking it in the air to the right of long off. Miller runs to his right and covers the ground but loses the grip on the ball while falling forward. Dropped!
full ball outside off and sliding across further. Outside the tram-lines this time
full ball wider outside off. Kishore bowling to the field with off-side bigger from this end. Plays away from his body and hits it to deep extra cover
offcutter, good length ball on middle. Swings across the line but there's protection at deep square leg and deep midwicket
length ball around off. Punched by the left-hand batter to the off side, but to the fielder at cover
this time along the ground to deep midwicket. Length ball that he clobbered across the line
Brar gets it away for another important boundary. Fuller ball around off and he swings across the line. Gets enough power behind that shot to get the slower ball away for four
short ball on middle and leg. Doesn't bounce enough to trouble the batter. Swivels and hammers a pull, playing it purposely behind square to beat the outfielder
good length ball on middle. Tries the pull but it hits him on the body instead. They scurry across for a leg bye
a tidy over from the part-timer. Full ball outside leg stump. Bhatia punches it past SRK to long off
full ball outside leg stump but Bhatia is also leg-side of the stumps, and therefore he can clip it comfortably off his toes. Towards midwicket for a couple
Shahrukh avoids the stumps this time. Full and a shade outside off stump. Driven towards long off for a single
lands between long on and deep midwicket before either fielder could get there. Full on leg and he used his feet to try and hit a big shot in the gap on the leg side in front of square
full ball outside leg. Bhatia stays leg-side of the ball and comes down the track. Drilled to long on

more spin, SRK is here, and has he struck first ball? He comes around the stumps, bowls a full ball around off, and it's rather skiddy too. Bhatia tries the sweep, but misses, and it hits his pad. Umpire was quick to raise his finger but the batter reviews the call and it is the right decision - missing leg stump. Another error goes down in the umpire's column
boundary for Brar! Fullish ball on middle, and he gets low to drag a sweep to deep square leg for four!
a whippy release this time from Sai, exerting a bit more pace to this delivery, while coming around the stumps. Gets the ball to angle across and Bhatia cuts it to deep backward point
length ball around off. Clipped to deep midwicket for a couple this time
full ball around off. Comes down the track and pushes it to the off side

his third wicket! Sai has been varying his pace, forcing mis-hits and mistakes, and this time Shashank hits it right back to the bowler. Sai bowls a length ball, flat, and Shashank comes down the track to meet it. But he cannot get the bat swing through the ball, instead bunting a catch straight back to Sai
good length ball worked off his pads with the bat's closed face to midwicket. Acres of space in that region on this big ground
guides this shot towards the deep backward point fielder who keeps it down to one. Rashid finishes his quota with 4-0-15-1
around the stumps. Full ball outside off. Singh drives towards backward point for a single
googly worked off his pads off the back foot to square leg for a single
full ball outside off. Turning away. Bit slower from Rashid. Harpreet tries to push it away from his body and gets an outside edge to short third
full ball around off stump, and he presses forward before fending
full, zippy ball landing outside off and turning away. Harpreet misses the attempted off-side punch
full ball around off stump and pushed to the off side for a single

holes out at deep extra cover! Sai goes fullish outside off. Ashutosh uses his feet to get to the pitch but he's a bit late into the shot. Decent hit, but decent is not good enough for Mullanpur's dimensions. Taken on the boundary line

Shashank lucky! Sai beats him in flight as Shashank comes down the track for an aggressive shot. He was through the shot a tad too early and the ball went high up. Miller runs in from long off but it falls short of him
fullish ball around off stump. Blocked with a compact defense technique
full ball on middle and he plays a shot to long on for a single

LBW appeal first ball after the time out. Bowler and keeper look excited but not given. Titans review tentatively and we see this full ball outside off went into his pads with the bowler's angle from around the stumps. Yes, this is sliding down the leg side, and height is a factor too
full ball around leg stump. Nurdled to the leg side for only a single and Noor finishes with 4-0-20-2
full ball on leg. Inside out drive to long off on this occasion for a single
dip and curl on this ball as it lands around leg. Driven to long on for a single
length ball on leg and turning to off. Fended off the back foot
gets low to play a sweep, but can't connect well. Gets it to short fine leg
flat delivery and he plays a punchy shot to the cover region
full ball just outside off. Bit of turn away. Knocked to the off side with the turn. Bit of a yes-no-yes-no between the two
full ball on middle stump and he blocks it back to the bowler

oh that's simply beautiful from Sai! Drags his length back, slows it in the air, and deceives Jitesh. The batter came charging down to try and hit another big shot after two dots, but the ball lands well before him, turns across, goes under his bat, and crashes into the stumps
flat again. Fullish on off. Skidding into him. Blocked back
full ball around off stump and Jitesh presses forward to block. Flatter delivery
is this the bowler they take on! Comes around the stumps and bowls fullish on off. Jitesh dances down the track and clubs Sai over long off
full ball on middle and off. Shashank drives with the bat's open face and plays it to cover
full ball around leg stump. Tries to play it down the ground with the straight bat and very nearly gave Noor a catching chance to his right. Eventually goes to long on for a single
good length ball around off. Turning away. Punched to the off side and off the mark
full ball on middle and off stump. Presses forward and defends to the off side

first slip plan pays off! Length ball around off. Googly takes it across Livingstone. Batter tries to flick against the turn to midwicket, and that induces the outside edge. Ball goes quickly to Tewatia, but he sticks his hands out to his right to grab onto it
plays it fine! Overpitched ball just outside leg. Livingstone gets low and plays a beautiful paddle sweep, giving it direction, and sending first slip to a mighty chase to fine leg
length ball outside off. Bit of turn away. Sharma carefully nurdles it to the off side. Ten over mark
stays in his crease and punches to long on for one
good length ball on middle stump. Skids through. Tries to flick, but some extra bounce there, and he misses getting bat on ball
full ball just outside off. Jitesh raises his back leg while hitting an aggressive drive with the turn to long off
good length ball outside off. Bit of turn away. Cut to point, but the fielder can't stop it properly, and Titans leak two runs with the outfielder cleaning the situation up
full ball just outside off and Jitesh opts to fend this off the front foot
teases the outside edge! Livingstone struggling to pick Noor here as he gets this fullish ball on off to turn away a bit and whiz past Livingstone's bat
length ball on off and turning away. Livingstone tries to play off the back foot through the off side but fails to get bat on ball
full ball pitching outside leg. Turning into Livingstone as he misses a defensive shot. Hits the pad. LBW appeal turned down.
full ball on middle and off. Turning away from Jitesh. He gets forward and knocks it gently towards point for a single
stays on the back foot and clips it to the leg side for a single
full ball pitching just outside leg and turning into the stumps. Clipped off the  back foot to the leg side for a single
full ball around off stump. Gets forward and fends this first ball

full ball around leg stump and doesn't turn either way Curran tries to knock it leg side but he's beaten, and the ball hits him on the knee roll. Appeal for LBW - but not given, however, Gill reviews again. What do we have here.... another umpire error, and another Titans wicket on review! Pitched on leg stump, hit him on leg stump, and crashing into leg stump. Gill jumps onto Rashid to celebrate
full ball on off. Googly is punched off the back foot to deep extra cover, and the big pocket there allows him two
off the mark, Jitesh. Fullish ball outside off and turning in. Uses his wrists to flick it in front of square to the deep
length ball skidding on. Pushed to mid on this time for a single
full ball on middle. Googly. Tries to push it to mid on but it hits the bat's outside half and rolls away to mid off instead

big lbw call next ball! Full ball outside off and turning in. Rossouw gets down to sweep but it hits his pad. They scurry across for a leg bye as the umpire says not out. Gujarat Titans review and the ball-tracking shows that is plumb lbw. Turning in enough to crash into leg stump. Rossouw tried to rely on the sweep against the turning ball but Noor outfoxed him there

poor fielding effort and a single becomes four. Full ball just outside off and Rossouw gets low to play the reverse sweep. Turning into him, and played against the turn. Warrier the guilty man. Gill isn't happy
good length ball just outside off. Turning in a bit. Rossouw attempts a cut from near his body. Edged onto the deck
overpitched ball, quite wide. Curran reaches out and mistimes a cut for one
full ball outside off. Turning away. Gently fends the first ball to the off side
full ball outside off. Googly drilled to deep point but the field is now spread out
good length ball around off. Punchy shot towards cover, but can't clear the infield
bangs it short, and Rossouw semi-ducks. Offers no shot. Umpire says that's a fair ball
searches for the wide yorker. Doesn't land it well. Rossouw reaches out and helps the ball to the backward point fence!
another promising Prabhsimran innings cut short in the IPL! Fullish ball just outside off. Singh comes down the track to try and loft it over cover but gets an edge to the keeper instead
smart cricket! Drags the ball a bit short, and enough width for Singh to utilise as he upar-cuts a shot over the short-third man fielder!
full ball around off and Curran swats this across the line to hit it to mid on's left for a single
length ball on a fourth-stump line. Singh hangs back and pulls in front of square. Can't beat the infield
full ball on leg, and comfortably nudged off his pads to square leg
full ball on off. Googly cut in front of square from close to his body
full ball just outside off. A compact tap-and-run to the off side
Singh backs away before Rashid bowls. So the bowler delivers a full ball wide outside off. Singh has to reach out and cut to the off side
full ball on leg. Turning to middle. Worked to mid on's left for a single
gets a shot away to deep square leg for a single
full ball from over the stumps to the right-hander. Cutter, full just outside off. Bunted to the off side for a single
coming around the stumps now. Good length ball angling in, and a mistimed punch to mid on
slower ball bouncer on leg stump. Curran hangs back and lets the ball balloon over his head
length ball on off. Bit of angle across Curran. Tries to punch through mid off but hits the inside half of the bat
bends his back.  Short ball on leg stump. Curran tries to pull but the ball goes over him. Took his eyes off the ball
could've been a first-ball wicket had there been a slip fielder. Length ball angling across, but rising, and the cut takes a thick edge through the cordon. Could Saha have dived?
rolls his fingers over this delivery. Fullish ball just outside off and tapped to the off side
comes down the track again this time. Bowler bowls a fullish ball outside off. Nurdled to the off side
length ball angling into his waist, and Singh unleashes his strong wrists onto this one, flicking it amazingly over deep backward square leg! BLOCKBUSTER
back of a length ball around off. Comes down the track. Tries to cut but the angle jags in sharply, and he mistimes the shot onto his body
fullish ball on middle stump, and tapped to the off side for a single
fullish ball around off stump. Curran gets in position nice and early to drill a boundary between the small gap between point and cover point
width offered, and clattered away! Short, wide, and just perfect for an opening batter in the powerplay. Over cover point
puts it away! And it is a no ball too! Tries to follow Singh with a back of a length ball angling in. But he moves further down the leg side before slicing a shot uppishly over deep backward point
full ball around off and he dances down the track before clattering a shot over cover's left!
full ball around off and he uses his wrists to flick it to deep backward square leg
length ball just outside off. Red-ball cricket length. Tries to play the punch but misses
length ball around off stump. Tries to move off side and pull over the leg side but gets an edge onto his body
full ball swings into his pads, and he clips it well enough to send it behind fine leg for four!
full ball outside off stump. Prods forward and drives it steadily to mid off's left
fullish ball on middle and swinging into his pads. Misses the flick, hits the leg
back of a length ball around off, but trailing into the batter. Singh gives the bowler a charge but ends up cramped. Mistimed to the leg side
good length ball moving away laterally. Defends the first ball away
fullish ball on middle and driven to mid on for a single
full ball swinging into and Curran toe-ends a drive to the leg side
too straight, glanced to the boundary, Titans win by three wickets! It was far from convincing but GT give their campaign a lift with a fourth victory to move back into the midtable mix
full toss, scooped to midwicket! Titans continue to make a meal of the chase. Rashid picks out Rossouw for a good, low catch, smiles and walks off. Anyone else want to hit the winning run?
low full toss and Rashid skelps it off his pads for a couple into the deep. Scores are tied
pitched up in the channel and Tewatia bunts one through cover
round the wicket, full-length slower ball in the channel, 125kph. Swing and a miss
low full toss, deflected out through midwicket for one
yorked him! Full with pace off and it dips under the bat, flicks the boot and then hits off stump. Beautifully bowled but probably too late for Kings
four more, squirted wide of the keeper! Rabada goes back of a length, 149kph outside off but Tewatia drops the bat in time and gets enough on it to wrongfoot Jitesh
ice cold from Tewatia! Skips down and boshes four more back past the bowler. Poor ball, on a length and dispatched straight
goes for the yorker, dug out into the leg side for a single
bullied over long-off, quietens the crowd! Monster hit from Shahrukh, stepping into a slogged drive that goes hard and flat for six. Game over?
back of a length, takes a blow on the glove. The ball rolls towards square leg and they trot one. But Tewatia looks in some discomfort
smoked past mid-off! Length ball from Rabada and Tewatia glides forward to strike on the up between extra cover and mid-off for another vital boundary
fired across the bows at 97kph, Tewatia slashes another single out to deep backward point
speared down and hoicked to fine leg! A rolling, rising thump over the man in the circle and away for four more
tossed up and nurdled into the midwicket region, Brar trundles off in pursuit but can't prevent two
reverse-swiped through the ring! Tewatia gets hold of this one and beats the infield for a boundary
shovelled away into a gap in the leg side (left-hander's leg side)

Tewatia looks to reverse, pinned in front... but not given! And Kings have reviewed. This is going to be close. Did it pitch outside leg? Was there any glove involved? Nothing on UltraEdge but the ball did land outside leg stump (at least, theoretically leg stump, until Tewatia turned himself around in his stance). But that's the Law as it stands, so stays not out
pitched up wide of the stumps, 137kph and slashed down to deep third
full on fourth stump, 136kph and defended back down the track. Harshal cleans up in his follow through
pitched up from round the wicket, dabbed to point
full, wide, 134kph. Shahrukh thumps it out to deep cover
nicked behind, Harshal strikes! Hard length coming back at Azmat and he flashes at a drive, producing a fat edge through to the keeper. Kings are not letting this one go
low full toss, squirts off the outer half of the bat and beats backward point for a couple
length on fourth stump, 129kph, stabbed towards point
full, straight and tickled fine! Went for the wicket-taking ball but missed his yorker and Tewatia is off the mark with a boundary

chopped on! Sammy Cuz-Cuz strikes back! Length ball, scrambled seam and Sai plays a flat-footed jab that detonates his own stumps. Big wicket for Kings with Sai looking to anchor the chase. Curran making things happen in approved style
strays on to the pads and pays for it, just a flick from Sai but he picks up four with fine leg up
full and angling across the right-hander, Azmat biffs a drive to the cover sweeper
full outside off, Sai steps out to drive and thick-edges down to deep third
clipped down to long-on. Livingstone finishes with excellent figures of 2 for 19
googly, I think, again Azmat steps to leg, but ends up bunting one watchfully into the covers
flat outside off, 91kph and stabbed through point going back
clears the front leg... and pretty much the back leg, too. But then Azmat almost couldn't reach the ball trying to swing it down the ground. Single to long-off
tossed up and punched down the ground through mid-off
fired in straight, 96kph and worked straight to midwicket
flatter, skidding on, chopped into the ground looking to cut
put a donk on it! Azmat steps out and WALLOPS the first six of the Titans innings all the way back over long-on!
pushed through, 94kph on the pads and jabbed past midwicket for one more
sliding across the left-hander, Sai chops the ball straight to backward point
flat outside off and Azmat drops back to cut for a single
fired in and prodded back to the bowler
over the wicket, 90kph on off stump and pushed down to long-off

timbeeeeeeerrrrrrrrrr! No Miller Time for GT tonight. Livingstone has put him on ice. Another vein-popping celebration from Livingstone and Kings might just start to believe they can do this. The ball was tossed up and skidding under Miller's big swing across the line to rattle middle and leg stumps
lobbed up and clipped back past the bowler
Miller uses the feet and drives one more down to long-on
slows his pace to 84kph, but loses his line down leg
angling in and whipped through midwicket
full and drifting into the left-hander from round the wicket. Miller clips to long-on
pitched up and stroked past cover, worth a couple in front of the sweeper
length ball, driven on the up. Well stopped in the covers by the diving Rossouw
back of a length, 139kph and nibbling enough to beat the attempted back-foot punch
shortish, cramped for room, punched to mid-off
length ball, 140kph and played softly into the point region for another single
round the wicket, short of a length, 134kph and flicked through square leg
88kph offbreak, defended on the front foot
fired in at the stumps and glanced fine
tossed up and worked down to long-on

goes down the ground... but hasn't caught it! Livingstone roars in delight, he's got the big wicket of Gill. He stretched out to meet it but didn't get enough on the lofted shot and it's a comfortable catch for Rabada some way in from the rope at long-off. Gill gulled and Kings have a window of opportunity
flighted leggie, steered to point coming forwards
flat offbreak from round the wicket, 91kph and swept fine for a single
angled across at 95 clicks, cut away off the back foot to boundary rider behind square
paddled away fine, Brar loses his line and Sai gets low to deflect it past the keeper and away for four
flat outside off, Gill steps across and pushes one through cover
darted on off, 93kph and pushed back to the bowler's left, Brar diving across to make the stop
tossed up a bit more and steered down to long-off coming forwards
fired across the bows from round the wicket, Sai looks to cut but only manages a bottom edge into the pitch
97kph, sliding down the leg side, Gill attempts to paddle and gets the ball fine past the keep. Off the pads for leg byes
gets the length right this time, some spin for Livingstone's legbreak. Pushed back to the bowler
dragged down and crunched! Opts for legspin but the ball is short and sits up for Gill to power a cut well in front of the cover sweeper
drops back on off stump and slaps one away through the covers
pushed through and defended going back and across this time
offspin to the left-hander, slides this one past the inside edge... Kings go up for lbw but there's no review. Does Livi think he hit it? Yes, big edge into the pads, replays confirm
pushed through wide of the stumps at 94kph, again Gill finds a gap in the deep cutting
floated up towards the blockhole, Gill pushes it back to the bowler
flatter and swept fine for a single
length delivery pitching outside off and punched down the ground
flat outside off, 89kph and Gill cuts behind the point sweeper for two
round the wicket, tossed up on middle and leg. Sai clips one to wide long-on
boshed through point! Full and wide from Curran and he is slapped for a boundary to finish the powerplay
pitched up straight, Gill tucks it into the gap at midwicket for a couple
length delivery sliding in towards the pads, Sai flicks a single through square leg
back of a length and worked into the leg side, mid-on comes across
pitched up, Sai is forward and drives to mid-on
over the wicket, full outside off with a smidge of inswing, 129kph and stabbed through backward point for one
full outside off, 128kph and worked into the leg side as Gill comes across
length ball outside off, 135kph and steered through backward point for a single
round the wicket, full with pace off. Pushed into the covers
full on sixth stump, tapped into the covers and Gill sets off... beats the direct hit at the non-striker's!
length ball, thrashed to the fence! Width again, 141kph and Gill plays it very late, the ball racing away to the right of deep third
full length, Gill is forward and plinks it back down the track
back of a length, opens the face and tries to steer it down past slip. There's almost a run on an impetuous overthrow, but they think better of it
lashed through backward point for four first ball! Bit of width on offer and Sai sits back, opens the shoulders and pumps it wide of deep third

short and pulled... straight to midwicket! Arshdeep gets the breakthrough that Kings needed. Came off the toe of the bat and that's a simple catch for Ashutosh. Saha inspects his stick critically and then heads for the dugouts
short of a length and swatted, no great timing from Saha but he gets a couple wide of fine leg
length ball, 136kph and a hint of inswing. Punched back past the bowler towards mid-off
dropped behind point for a single
good comeback from Rabada, beats the edge as Gill fiddles outside off
clipped off the pads, four more... too full from Rabada and this time he uses the pace to whip it away. Deep square leg bypassed again
battered in front of square! Classy way to pick up his first boundary... slower ball and it sits up to be swatted in front of the boundary rider
pitched up, 143kph on middle and off. Gill stabs it back down the track
length ball, waits in the crease and opens the face, steals a single to short third
dug in outside off stump and Saha rides it to punch square
back of a length and swung away on the pull for another single. Quiet over from Arshdeep
134kph back of a length in the channel, punched to deep point with an angled bat
shortish on the stumps and paddled away through backward square leg
back of a length, GIll rides it and drops the ball softly into the off side for a quick single
shortish and wide, Gill looks to free the arms... but doesn't pull the trigger. Just steered towards backward point
over the wicket, angling across on off. Saha is forward and turns it off his front pad for one
fullish length in the channel, 139kph and dabbed down to deep third for one more
full and lashed through backward point, Saha steps out and throws the hands, picks up the first boundary of the innings
length ball on fourth stump, Gill is across and tucks it around the corner to square leg
back of a length into the body and tucked down to midwicket
touch fuller in the channel, 141kph and Gill steers towards point coming forwards
back of a length outside off, 137kph and jabbed down off an inside edge into the leg side behind square
